item.title: Instagram Plant Shop Announcement

turns.text: Make an Instagram feed post for a little houseplant shop. Lots of lush potted plants, clean cream background, headline “Bring home some green”. No other text.

item.tests: Checks that Instagram feed context leads to a square or 4:5 image without requiring the user to specify dimensions.

answer_sheet.Platform and dimensions: Instagram feed; either square or 4:5 portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Bring home some green” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Visual content and style: Lots of lush potted houseplants on a clean cream background.

must_haves: One finished image has either a 1:1 square or 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, not landscape or 9:16.
The headline reads exactly “Bring home some green”.
Multiple lush potted houseplants are clearly visible against a cream background.
The headline is readable at feed-viewing size, with no clipped letters.

turns.text: Make an Instagram feed post for a little houseplant shop. Lots of lush potted plants, clean cream background, headline “Bring home some green”. No other text. dialog.agent:
The cheapest listed option is **one square image at 640 × 640 px using Flux-2-Klein, starting at 5 credits**. It’s free-plan compatible, but I can’t verify your live balance or an exact account-specific charge with the tools available here. **I haven’t run anything or spent any credits.**

I’d make:
- Lots of lush, varied potted houseplants
- A clean cream background
- The headline **“Bring home some green”**
- No other text

**Cheaper or smaller?** One image at 640 px is the lowest listed size and cost. “Shorter” only applies to video; a still image avoids that expense. It’s suitable for a basic Instagram post, though below Instagram’s usual 1080 px width. AI-generated lettering may need correction, which could cost extra.

Would you like to proceed with this lowest-cost option, or would you prefer a **zero-generation-credit layout guide** to assemble yourself?

turns.agent:
The generation was refused because your account has **insufficient credits**. No image was made, and no generation credits were spent.

The lowest listed option starts at **5 credits**. A no-credit alternative is to build it in a free design editor: use a square cream canvas, arrange plant photos along the bottom and sides, and add **“Bring home some green”** in dark green at the top—with no other text.

args.name: Houseplant Shop — Bring home some green

style.prompt: Create a polished square Instagram feed advertisement for a small independent houseplant shop. Clean warm cream background, abundant lush green potted houseplants arranged beautifully across the bottom and framing the sides: monstera, pothos, fiddle-leaf fig, ferns, rubber plant and small trailing plants. Tasteful terracotta and cream ceramic pots, soft natural daylight, gentle realistic shadows, inviting boutique botanical photography with a clean editorial graphic layout. Keep generous uncluttered cream negative space in the upper center for a large clearly legible elegant dark forest green headline. Render the exact headline: “Bring home some green”. This headline is the ONLY text anywhere in the image. No subtitle, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no additional lettering. Balance lush foliage with refined simplicity; headline must be prominent and spelled exactly.
